annotations.title: The shipping gap on Etsy, and the fix price

description: Works out the shipping gap for an Etsy shop: what the label and packaging cost beyond what the buyer pays, per order and per month, and the fixes: the item price that covers the gap with shipping kept under Etsy's $6 search line, calculated shipping, and (for free-shipping shops) building shipping into items of $35 and up, each worth so much a month if orders hold. It fits a seller who charges less for shipping than the label costs, offers free shipping, or asks how to price shipping on Etsy. Takes the item price, shipping charged, label cost and orders a month; packaging (else $1 typical, flagged), the share of orders shipping free, the Offsite Ads rate and share, and materials are optional and sharpen the fix. Returns the gap, the fix price, every fix's monthly value and how far orders could fall before it leaves the seller worse off. US dollars; dated Etsy rules with sources. Free, no sign-in. Takes numbers only; nothing is stored.

freeShippingShare.description: Share of orders that ship free: a fraction (0.25), or a band. Default none.

itemPrice.description: Typical item price, US dollars, before shipping.

labelCost.description: What the shipping label costs, US dollars (Shop Manager > Finances > Payment account > Shipping).

materials.description: Optional: materials per item, US dollars. Adds how far orders could fall before each fix leaves the seller worse off.

offsiteAds.description: Optional: the shop's Offsite Ads rate. Fees on the higher price depend on it. Left out: estimated from orders × price, flagged. none is taken as off.

offsiteShare.description: Optional: share of sales from Offsite Ads. Left out: 10%, the figure Etsy gave at launch in 2020, flagged as a default.

orders.description: Orders in a typical month: a number from 1 to 100,000 (Shop Manager > Stats > Orders), or a band. Over 300: send the number.

packaging.description: Packaging per order in US dollars, or mailer (about $1), box (about $3) or not-sure. Left out: $1, a weakly sourced typical figure, flagged as a default.

shippingCharged.description: What the buyer pays for shipping on an order that isn't free, US dollars (0 if shipping is always free).

name: sellerprofit_shipping_gap

isDefault.description: True when the value isn't the seller's own number or tap: a default their own figure would replace.

additive.description: False when this fix's value is part of another fix's, not on top of it.

estimate.description: True when the fix's dollars rest on a third-party rate (Amazon's fulfillment fees): say "about" and "estimated" when quoting it.

monthly.description: What the fix is worth a month in US dollars, at the seller's numbers, if orders hold; null when no monthly total can be known.

ordersCanFall.description: How far orders could fall (a fraction) before the fix leaves the seller worse off; null when there's no limit or it doesn't apply.

text.description: The fix in plain words, with its condition ("if orders hold").

link.description: Opens the matching page on sellerprofitdoctor.com. Carries none of the figures sent.

priceFix.description: The item price that covers the gap with shipping kept as is (under $6 when it is today).

rates.description: Which rules the numbers use, as of when, and where they come from.

asOf.description: The day the platform's fee table was last checked against its sources (YYYY-MM-DD).

estimatesLine.description: Amazon only: which rates are third-party estimates (FBA, storage, returns and the rest sit behind the Seller Central login). Say so when citing them.

recheckBy.description: The day the table is due for its next check.

searchLine.description: Etsy favors US listings with shipping under this in search (calculated shipping is left out of the rule).

shippingCost.description: Label + packaging per order, US dollars.

title: The shipping gap on Etsy, and the fix price
